name: tmcra-memory
description: Automatic long-term memory recall and capture for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Automatic long-term memory for coding agents.
interface.longDescription: Recall relevant TMCRA memory before Codex answers, capture completed turns, and preserve long-running tasks across automatic context compaction with redacted tool-progress checkpoints. Includes explicit MCP tools for inspecting recall, ingestion, jobs, runtime status, and local model-provider settings.
